summary: Frontend-only E2E test of SqueezeCase (homepage + PDP /prodotto/panda-rosso) via public URL. Verified: zero horizontal overflow at 320/375/390/414/768px on both pages; dusty-rose palette applied with zero residual #F2542D (rgb 242,84,45) computed anywhere; hero 3D canvas renders and drag/click on canvas causes no page errors; PDP gallery order (3D first with gallery-3d-hint, video thumb second, then images) and thumb switching; sticky buy box on 1920px (top stays 72-96px after 1500px scroll); mobile (390px) ordering how-its-made(2920)/benefits(3528)/lifestyle(3932) all AFTER buy box(761); video-reviews-section (2539) before reviews-section (3463) on desktop; coupon SQUEEZE15 -> 'Applicato'; model search 'Pixel 9' -> 4 options -> model-summary-chip 'Pixel 9' with 3D still rendered; qty +/- (44x44px); add-to-cart blocked without model (no drawer) and working with model -> cart drawer shows 34,90 € subtotal, -5,24 € coupon, total 29,67 € (correct); variant-swatch-gatto navigates to /prodotto/gatto with 3D intact; FAQ accordion open/close; footer newsletter -> POST /api/newsletter 200 + success toast 'Benvenuto nel club!'; API /api/health 200 and /api/newsletter validation 422 for invalid email. ONE CRITICAL runtime error found (confetti/site.theme).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL uncaught TypeError on coupon apply: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'confetti')" — site.theme does NOT exist in /app/frontend/src/config/site.js, so site.theme.confetti throws. Coupon state still applies, but the exception aborts the handler after setState and in the dev preview it raises the webpack-dev-server runtime-error overlay (fixed iframe, z-index 2147483647, full viewport) which then BLOCKS EVERY subsequent click on the page (model selection, add-to-cart, gallery toggle all became unclickable until the overlay was removed). Same root cause means App.js palette injection (site.theme?.[key]) never runs — --sc-* CSS vars resolve empty and only index.css defaults are used.

React console error 'Encountered two children with the same key, 14' — countdown renders <motion.span key={mm}> and <motion.span key={ss}> as siblings; keys collide whenever minutes == seconds (reproduced at 14:14). Use static keys like key={`m-${mm}`} / key={`s-${ss}`}.

16 duplicated data-testids in the DOM because HowItsMade/BenefitsStrip/LifestyleParallax are rendered both in the lg:block column and the lg:hidden mobile container: how-its-made, how-its-made-eyebrow/title, layer-shell, layer-bumper, layer-nose, layer-caption, benefits-strip, benefit-card-* (4), lifestyle-parallax, lifestyle-eyebrow, lifestyle-image-0/1. Breaks strict-mode automation and duplicates DOM/images weight; suggest CSS-only reordering (order-*) or suffixed testids.

The 3 layer buttons are absolutely stacked with only ~18% offset, and the active layer gets z-index 10 + scale 1.04, so the geometric CENTER of layer-bumper/layer-nose is always covered by the active layer (Playwright normal click on layer-bumper times out: 'layer-shell subtree intercepts pointer events'; force-click on center also hits the wrong layer). Layers ARE selectable only via the small exposed edge/'+' hotspot area. Recommend adding a dedicated clickable hotspot with its own data-testid (e.g. layer-hotspot-bumper) or a tab-strip fallback.

The gallery video (and video reviews) use https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/*.mp4 (H.264). File is reachable (HTTP 200, video/mp4) but this headless Chromium has no H.264 support (canPlayType('avc1')=''), so playback could NOT be verified: video.error=4, readyState=0, autoplay never starts. App-side defect: no error/onError fallback (poster stays but no UI feedback) and the toggle button keeps showing the Pause icon while the video is actually paused/failed (playing state not synced to play/pause/error events). Consider a webm source and syncing state via onPlay/onPause/onError.

issues: The 'bumper' layer face renders as an almost empty white card that fully hides the printed shell photo when active — reads as a broken/blank image rather than a TPU bumper (consider transparent center so the layer beneath shows through).
Secondary copy ('Sconti, nuovi musi e lanci in anteprima…' and payment chips) is low-contrast grey on the dark brown footer — verify >=4.5:1.

action_items: CRITICAL: add the missing `theme` object (incl. `confetti` colors array) to /app/frontend/src/config/site.js OR guard CouponCard (site.theme?.confetti ?? fallback). Current state throws an uncaught TypeError on every coupon apply and the resulting dev-overlay blocks all further clicks in the preview URL.
Fix duplicate React keys in CouponCard countdown (key collision when mm == ss).
De-duplicate the 16 duplicated data-testids caused by rendering HowItsMade/Benefits/Lifestyle twice (desktop + mobile).
Make HowItsMade layers reliably clickable (dedicated hotspot button/testid; centers are covered by the active layer).
Add onError/onPlay/onPause handling for the gallery video and consider a webm/self-hosted source; sync the play/pause icon with real video state.
critical_code_review_comments: site.theme is referenced in CouponCard.jsx and App.js but is not defined in config/site.js — the 'config-driven palette' claim is not actually wired at runtime (only index.css defaults apply).
Gallery video `playing` state is initialised to true and only mutated inside toggleVideo — it never reflects autoplay failure or media errors.
ProductPage duplicates whole subtrees for responsive ordering instead of CSS ordering, doubling DOM/image requests and testids.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Overflow (320/375/390/414/768), palette, gallery order, sticky buy box, mobile block ordering, coupon/model/qty/add-to-cart/cart totals, variant navigation, FAQ and newsletter all verified PASS. Two things to know: (1) after clicking coupon-apply-button a webpack-dev-server runtime-error overlay iframe appears and swallows all clicks — remove it in scripts with document.getElementById('webpack-dev-server-client-overlay').remove() until the confetti bug is fixed; (2) headless Chromium here has no H.264 codec, so any .mp4 (gallery video + video reviews) cannot play — validate only DOM/poster/toggle wiring, not playback.
rca_of_the_issue: CouponCard imports canvas-confetti and calls confetti({..., colors: site.theme.confetti}). /app/frontend/src/config/site.js exports no `theme` key (grep confirms zero occurrences), so `site.theme` is undefined and reading `.confetti` throws TypeError. React/CRA surfaces the uncaught error through the webpack-dev-server overlay iframe (position fixed, z-index 2147483647, full viewport) which intercepts pointer events, making the whole page appear unclickable after applying the coupon. Fix: define site.theme (accent/nose/confetti palette) or optional-chain with a fallback color array.
